main_text.head: Quot sunt species Simplicium notarum?
main_text.p: Octo: Maxima [music symbol: maxima] valens tactibus octo.
Longa [music symbol: longa] valens tactibus quatuor.
Brevis [music symbol: brevis] valens tactibus duobus.
Semibrevis [music symbol: semibrevis] valens tactu uno.
Minima hæc est [music symbol: minima] Duæ minimæ valent tactu uno.
Semiminima hæc [music symbol: semiminima] Quatuor semiminimæ valent tactu uno.
Fusa hæc [music symbol: fusa] Octo fusæ valet tactu uno.
Semifusa hæc [music symbol: semifusa] Sedecim semifusæ valent tactu uno.

page.notes: The "Octo:" in the first line is printed as "Octo" with a long-s form; read as "Octo" (octo). Music symbols are described in brackets where they stand, as they are not letters. The printed line "Idem est in notis simplicibus, sive cau-" ends the page in mid-word; the word continues on the next page. Text printed "Octo:Maxima" appears in the source as "Octo:Maxima" with the colon directly after Octo; the first word may be a printed abbreviation of "Octo" or a misprint for "Oct." and is uncertain [?].
